The sequence is 9, x, 81, so x is the average of 9 and 81: (9 + 81)/2 = 45.

Solution A computes the common difference as 72/2 = 36, giving x = 9 + 36 = 45. This is correct.

Solution B sets up the equation correctly and gets 2x = 90, so x = 45. It then makes an invalid step, splitting 3^4/2 as 40, and arrives at 49, which is wrong.

WINNER: A
